scope: Eight preselected train-video windows, one h9 frame each, four decoder/code combinations

observations.warm_decoder: Preserves the two known anchors but shows substantial black regions, ghosting or incorrect geometry in multiple other sampled windows.
observations.sweep05_decoder: Recovers recognizable static block structures in several non-anchor samples, while the yellow and green moving pieces regress in the two known anchors and the green object is not clearly preserved in start 112.

limitations: One horizon per window cannot demonstrate motion continuity
Color and geometry are visually assessed without manual instance segmentation
Not cross-video validation or independent native GS replay
